mapper.select: SELECT news_id, title, cover_image, view_count, is_top, create_time FROM sys_news WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY is_top DESC, create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_news WHERE status = 1
SELECT * FROM sys_news WHERE news_id = #{newsId} AND status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_news SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE news_id = #{newsId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_news (title, cover_image, content, view_count, is_top, status, create_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{coverImage}, #{content}, 0, #{isTop}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_news SET title = #{title}, cover_image = #{coverImage}, content = #{content}, is_top = #{isTop}, status = #{status} WHERE news_id = #{newsId}
UPDATE sys_news SET status = #{status} WHERE news_id = #{newsId}
UPDATE sys_news SET is_top = #{isTop} WHERE news_id = #{newsId}
